text:
Generally PIBA accepts short documents in English without translation - so I would just submit. There is a very, very small chance they will ask you to make a translation + notarization, but if they do they will give you time to prepare this. 

For the photos, we would put in about 10 pages with 3 or 4 photos each page - with a one line explanation for each set of photos (e.g. "13 to 20 May 2026 - Trip to Italy with Friends" or "With Family for Shavot 2026). But there isn't a fixed way of doing this
